Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity uplift request & monthly commit rework

Hi Jordan,

We need to revisit our committed usage and rate limits for the Hosted API ahead of our Q3 seasonal peak. Current monthly commit (50M token-equivalent) is no longer sufficient — we've run into throttling twice in the last month and are seeing queue latency on high-concurrency routes.

Request: can Redwood propose options to move to a higher committed tier (targeting ~120M token-equivalent / month) and update per-route rate limits so our Checkout and Search routes get higher sustained TPS? Also include burst pocket / short-term credit options and the expected price impact.

Our procurement team (cc'd) will need an updated order form and any required SLAs or change notes for the contract. We prefer a 12-month extension if the economics are favorable.

Thanks,
Amit Shah
Head of Platform
ParcelPro

Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Capacity uplift request & monthly commit rework

Hi Amit — thanks for the heads up and the log snippet. Helpful context.

Two pragmatic paths we typically propose for customers in this situation:

1) Committed-tier uplift (recommended): move to a 120M/month commit, 12-month term, with a 12% committed discount vs list. Includes a 25% burst pocket (usable each month) and soft-throttle thresholds to protect latency-sensitive routes. Expected uplift price: incremental $X/month (I’ll include numbers in the order form).

2) Step-up bridge + seasonal cushion: keep current commit for 3 months, add a temporary peak cushion (prepaid burst credits) and re-evaluate after Q3. Lower up-front cost, faster time to provision.

Operational asks from our side: Marissa will propose a ramp validation plan (latency/cold-cache checks) and recommend route-specific rate allocations (Checkout & Search). Kimberley (cc) will need confirmation on term/discount for legal/ops.

I’ve attached a first-pass proposal PDF and will follow with an updated order form if you prefer option (1). Can we schedule a 30-min sync Monday 3/5 to finalize?

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0122
